content: Avoid the company of the foolish who can neither understand truth nor accept wise counsel. (Kural 849)
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation:
In the Sangam masterpiece of the Tirukkural, Thiruvalluvar provides a universal ethical compass for integrating righteous duty (*Aram*), practical prosperity (*Porul*), and enduring human nobility.

This passage emphasizes the vital importance of avoid and company in human life. By moving beyond superficial distractions and grounding attention in timeless ethical principles, we cultivate inner stability, clarity of thought, and genuine resilience.

True realization is never an abstract academic debate—it is an active discipline practiced through conscious daily choices and unwavering integrity.
